comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Reload a running server
themes.text: `nvs reload` makes a running server use the files that are on the disk now. It tells you when the server runs the new files.

themes.title: Tests that reach every part of a program
themes.text: A test can set the client address, cookies and the request body. It can run a command program and read its exit code and output. It can also read the logs and the mail a test caused.

themes.title: Faster answers from nvs code
themes.text: `nvs code` uses the same index as the editor. It does not analyse an unchanged project again. The first index of a project uses every processor core. One `calls` or `reach` command can take several methods.
